cohort: 130 live born infants of diabetic mothers at Deenanath Mangeshkar Hospital, Pune, India, from April 2011 to April 2012.
finding: Neonatal complications (excluding preterm and large/small for gestational age infants) were present in 67% of infants of diabetic mothers, with hypoglycemia being the most common (48.46%).
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred in 40.7% of cases (with assistance in 35% of these), while Cesarean sections were performed in 59.2% of cases.
birth_weight: 20% low birth weight, 32.23% large for gestational age, 63.63% appropriate for gestational age, and 4.13% small for gestational age (based on Indian growth curves)
